text:
Imani Rivera: Hi team — excited to join! Laptop showed up and I9m blocked on SSH to the jump host: `Permission denied (publickey)`. Also where do I pick up a badge if I9m in SF next week? Who9s my mentor? Fun fact: I9m an indoor rock climber and bring my chalk bag everywhere.
Carlos Vega: Welcome Imani! I9m your mentor, nice to meet you. Badge pickup is Lobby C 9-4 (photo ID). If remote we ship a temporary sticker 1 DM Priya with address.
Priya Gomez: Added to #new-hires and #ml-team. Lunch intro on Friday 12pm PT (optional).
Carlos Vega: For the SSH issue try:
```
ssh-add ~/.ssh/id_ed25519 && ssh -v irivera@jump.redwood.internal
# confirm public key is in GitLab (Profile > SSH Keys)
```
If you still see permission denied, DM me the `ssh -v` output (mask hostnames).
it-bot: Reminder: VPN/jumpbox require CompanyMDM enrollment before access is granted.
mdm-bot: Enroll steps: install CompanyMDM, sign in with @redwood.com, enter emailed code, accept prompts. Policies apply in ~5-10m. Reply "enrolled" when done.
Imani Rivera: Installing MDM now and will add my pubkey to GitLab. Quick timezone note: I9m PST+11 (Melbourne) so mostly async is best. Thanks all! Also: I9ll bring climbing photos for the team channel :)
ops-bot: If SSH still fails after MDM and key upload, open an ops ticket and include `ssh -v` output and the key fingerprint.
Imani Rivera: Enrolled and added key 1 re-ran ssh - still permission denied, sending `ssh -v` to Carlos in DM. Appreciate the help!
